topicTitle: Frog (Rana tigrina): Habit and habitat, external features
notes: **Habit and habitat:** amphibious, lives in water and on land. Found near ponds, lakes, streams. Nocturnal, feeds on insects.

**Body division:** head (no neck, eyes with nictitating membrane, tympanum for hearing), trunk (no tail in adult, short forelimbs with 4 fingers, long hindlimbs with 5 webbed toes for swimming), cloaca (common exit for digestive, urinary and reproductive tracts).
**Skin:** moist, glandular, mucus-secreting for cutaneous respiration. Pigmented for camouflage. Mucous glands keep skin moist; poison glands in some species.
**Skeletal adaptations:** vertebral column short and rigid. Skull flattened. Hindlimbs elongated with fused bones (tibiofibula) for jumping. Urostyle supports hindlimbs.
**Digestive system:** alimentary canal short because carnivorous diet. Tongue bifid at tip, attached at front, free at back, thrown out to catch prey.
